US licensed information recommends that the interval between titra- tion steps is increased to 14 days in those patients with CC of 20 to 60 mL/minute. Parkinsonism. Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist used in the treatment of Parkinson’s disease (p.791) as an adjunct to levo- dopa therapy to reduce ‘off’ periods with levodopa and amelio- rate other fluctuations of mobility in the later stages of the dis- ease. It is also used as monotherapy early in the course of the disease in an attempt to delay therapy with levodopa. References. 1. Parkinson Study Group.
